dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Just keep your feet on the ground and work hard, and one day...

dialogues.speaker: Urville
dialogues.text: Nadia said the same thing. You're all more knowledgeable about this than I am, so I'll trust you.

dialogues.speaker: Urville
dialogues.text: Actually, working here is a solid gig. It keeps you busy, unlike before when I was treasure hunting outside. You could go for days, or even weeks, without any discoveries.

dialogues.speaker: Urville
dialogues.text: You're right! I should work hard and be diligent from today onwards!
